nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor; target of onlyOwner checks and recipient of reset().
ESCBAirdropper.airdropTokens: public token accounting variable, never written after deployment.
ESCBAirdropper.totalClaimed: cumulative tokens distributed; updated after external token transfers in airdrop/airdropDynamic/getFreeTokens.
ESCBAirdropper.amountOfTokens: static per-recipient payout amount, owner-settable via changeTokenAmount and used in airdrop/getFreeTokens.
ESCBAirdropper.tokensReceived: mapping(address=>bool) double-claim guard, written after the external transfer call.
ESCBAirdropper.craneList: mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by getFreeTokens.
ESCBAirdropper.airdropAgent: mapping(address=>bool) privilege mapping controlling onlyAirdropAgent.
ESCBAirdropper.token: ERC20 handle used for external transfer/balanceOf calls.
ESCBAirdropper.craneEnabled: boolean gate for the free-token crane, toggled by owner.
Library mul with assert(c/a==b) overflow guard.
Library div: unchecked truncating division.
Library sub with assert(b<=a) underflow guard.
Library add with assert(c>=a) overflow guard.
Ownable constructor: owner = msg.sender.
Access-control modifier require(msg.sender == owner).
Owner-only ownership transfer guarded by onlyOwner and a zero-address check.
Constructor: initializes totalClaimed, amountOfTokens and the ERC20 token address.
Static-amount batch airdrop; loops over recipients, does external transfer before setting tokensReceived, then updates totalClaimed.
Dynamic-amount batch airdrop; per-recipient transfer then per-recipient totalClaimed addition.
Owner-only grant/revoke of airdrop agent privileges.
Owner-only sweep of remaining tokens back to owner via external transfer.
Owner-only replacement of the ERC20 token handle.
Owner-only setter for the static airdrop amount.
Owner-only toggle of the craneEnabled flag.
View helper returning token.balanceOf(this).
Agent-only addition of recipients to the crane whitelist.
Public crane claim: checks craneList/msg.sender and tokensReceived, transfers amountOfTokens, then marks tokensReceived and updates totalClaimed.
Access-control modifier require(airdropAgent[msg.sender]).
State-gate modifier require(craneEnabled).
Caller-controlled address used by constructors, modifiers and getFreeTokens.
token.transfer(_recipients[i], amountOfTokens) external call performed before the tokensReceived flag is written.
token.transfer(_recipients[i], _amount[i]) external call performed before the tokensReceived flag is written.
token.transfer(owner, remainingTokens()) external call inside reset().
token.transfer(msg.sender, amountOfTokens) external call executed before tokensReceived[msg.sender] is set.
token.balanceOf(this) external call to a caller-independent but foreign contract.
Raw multiplication amountOfTokens * _recipients.length without SafeMath, which can overflow before being added to totalClaimed.
Constructor parameter _amount of ESCBAirdropper.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress of ESCBAirdropper.
Recipient array parameter of airdrop.
Loop counter i inside airdrop.
Recipient array parameter of airdropDynamic.
Loop counter i inside airdropDynamic.
Per-recipient amount array parameter of airdropDynamic.
Agent address parameter of setAirdropAgent.
Boolean flag parameter of setAirdropAgent.
New token address parameter of changeTokenAddress.
New static amount parameter of changeTokenAmount.
Crane status parameter of changeCraneStatus.
Recipient array parameter of addAddressToCraneList.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns the caller address msg.sender into owner.
Constructor parameter _amount is stored into amountOfTokens.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress is cast to ERC20 and stored into token.
Recipient addresses from _recipients flow into the token.transfer destination.
amountOfTokens is the value argument of token.transfer inside airdrop.
amountOfTokens is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
_recipients.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
The unchecked product feeds totalClaimed, so overflow is not caught by SafeMath.
Recipient addresses from _recipients flow into token.transfer inside airdropDynamic.
Per-recipient amounts from _amount flow into the token.transfer value argument.
Each transferred _amount[i] is accumulated into totalClaimed via SafeMath.add.
msg.sender indexes the tokensReceived double-claim guard in getFreeTokens.
msg.sender is the destination of token.transfer in getFreeTokens.
amountOfTokens is the value argument of token.transfer in getFreeTokens.
amountOfTokens is added into totalClaimed in getFreeTokens.
_agentAddress is the key written into the airdropAgent privilege mapping.
The state flag is the value written into the airdropAgent mapping.
_tokenAddress replaces the token handle in changeTokenAddress.
_amount is written into amountOfTokens by the owner.
_status is written into craneEnabled.
_recipients entries are flagged true in craneList.
newOwner is assigned to owner after the zero-address check.
The token handle is the target of the balanceOf external call.
The balanceOf result is passed as the value of token.transfer in reset.
owner is the destination of the sweep transfer in reset.
craneEnabled is the state read by the whenCraneEnabled gate.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to authorize privileged functions.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setAirdropAgent is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
reset is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeTokenAddress is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeTokenAmount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeCraneStatus is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyAirdropAgent looks up airdropAgent[msg.sender] to authorize callers.
airdrop is gated by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
airdropDynamic is gated by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
addAddressToCraneList is gated by the onlyAirdropAgent modifier.
getFreeTokens is gated by the whenCraneEnabled modifier.
getFreeTokens performs the external token.transfer call.
airdrop performs the external token.transfer call inside its loop.
airdropDynamic performs the external token.transfer call inside its loop.
reset performs the external token.transfer sweep call.
remainingTokens performs the external token.balanceOf call.
A malicious token can re-enter airdrop during the transfer, before tokensReceived is set, allowing repeated payouts.
A malicious token can re-enter airdropDynamic during the transfer, before tokensReceived is set.
getFreeTokens marks tokensReceived only after token.transfer, so a re-entrant token can drain multiple payouts.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _amount only feeds the airdrop state amount and can be folded into the ESCBAirdropper constructor node.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress only initializes the token handle and belongs to the constructor node.
_recipients is the loop input of airdrop consumed by the transfer call and can be absorbed into the airdrop function node.
Loop counter i is a purely local iterator of airdrop and can be merged into the airdrop function node.
_recipients is the loop input of airdropDynamic and can be merged into the airdropDynamic function node.
Loop counter i is a purely local iterator of airdropDynamic and can be merged into the airdropDynamic function node.
_amount array is the per-recipient input of airdropDynamic and can be merged into the airdropDynamic function node.
_agentAddress only keys the airdropAgent mapping write in setAirdropAgent and can be merged into that function node.
The state boolean only supplies the airdropAgent mapping value in setAirdropAgent and can be merged into that function node.
_tokenAddress is the single assignment input of changeTokenAddress and can be merged into that function node.
_amount is the single assignment input of changeTokenAmount and can be merged into that function node.
_status is the single assignment input of changeCraneStatus and can be merged into that function node.
_recipients is the loop input of addAddressToCraneList and can be merged into that function node.
newOwner is the assignment input of transferOwnership and can be merged into that function node.
